plan: This is a second-price auction (I pay the second-highest bid if I win). In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others do. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me; bidding lower risks losing profitable auctions. With my value at $25, I should bid $25 to maximize expected profit.

This is a second-price auction format where I pay the second-highest bid if I win, not my own bid. In this setup, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value of $18. Bidding higher risks paying more than the item is worth to me if I win; bidding lower risks losing auctions I could have profitably won. Since this is a one-shot game with no repeated interaction to exploit, truthful bidding maximizes my expected profit.

This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid. In such auctions, the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my true value, regardless of what others do. Bidding my value ensures I win whenever my value exceeds the second-highest bid (profitable), and I don't overpay since I only pay the second-highest bid if I win. There's no benefit to shading or inflating my bid. My value is $31, so I will bid $31.
